decision: Reprimand (Driving). This is the driver's 1st reprimand of the season. Reason The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 14 went off track in turn 2, continued on the run-off and rejoined at high speed right in front of Car 16. Although Car 16 did not have to take any evasive measures, the Stewards determine that given the speed and the angle in which Car 14 came back on track, he rejoined in an unsafe manner.
fact: Leaving the track and rejoining unsafely in T3.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 c) of the International Sporting Code.
